personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Editorial Mobile twist (Serif headings)
personality_one_liner: A clean, appetizing, and highly organized digital cookbook where the food is the hero, accented by a warm, approachable culinary mascot.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for content. Use intentional padding to frame recipes. Thumb-zone access for primary actions.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar to allow scrolling content to bleed beneath.
Use glass on floating contextual action bars (e.g., 'Add to Plan' button on Recipe Detail).
Apply to sticky headers on Recipe Detail scrolling screens.
dont's: Never use glass on forms or body text regions.
Never use glass without a >70% translucent tinted base for readability.

screens.name: Home (Library)
screens.purpose: A visually appetizing grid of saved recipes with a prominent, easy-to-use 'Import Link' action.

states.empty: Mascot illustration looking eager with 'Paste a recipe link to start your cookbook!' and a large primary CTA.
states.error: Mascot looking confused, readable error message, and a Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with 'Import Recipe' input field or button. Horizontal scroll for Categories (Dinner, Vegan, 15-min). 2-column grid for recipe cards. Cards have full-bleed images at the top, a subtle gradient scrim if text overlays, or crisp text below the image.

screens.name: Recipe Detail
screens.purpose: Immersive cooking and reading experience for a specific recipe.

states.loading: Full screen skeleton with hero image placeholder.
states.empty: N/A - Screen only accessed if recipe exists.

screens.layout: Large hero image bleeding to the top edge. Gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at bottom of image if back/action buttons overlay it. Content split into 'Ingredients' and 'Steps' via segmented control. Sticky action bar at the bottom to 'Add to Meal Plan' or 'Add to Grocery List'.

screens.name: Meal Planner
screens.purpose: Organize recipes into a weekly schedule with drag/drop or tap-to-assign flow.

states.empty: Mascot holding an empty plate saying 'Your week is looking hungry! Add recipes to plan meals.'
states.error: Failed to sync meal plan, 'Retry' CTA.

screens.layout: Horizontal date selector at the top. Vertical list of meals for the selected day. Empty slots have dashed borders (surfaceTertiary) with a '+' icon. Filled slots show a condensed horizontal recipe card with an image thumbnail.

screens.name: Grocery List
screens.purpose: Shared shopping list automatically categorized by grocery aisles.

states.empty: Mascot with a shopping basket saying 'All stocked up! Add ingredients from your meal plan.'
states.error: Failed to sync shared list, 'Retry' CTA.

screens.layout: Header shows avatars of household members. List is grouped by category (Produce, Dairy, Pantry). Items have checkboxes. Tapping an item strikes it out and moves it to a collapsed 'Completed' section at the bottom.

onboarding_mascot.alt: Cute 3D chef mascot character holding a cake cutout

recipe_placeholder_1.alt: Delicious healthy meal overhead on a blue plate

empty_grocery_basket.alt: Fresh vegetables in a woven shopping basket

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use any blues or purples for buttons, links, or statuses. Use Terracotta (brandPrimary) for primary actions.

Typography: Use 'Lora' (Serif) ONLY for large Display/Headlines (e.g., Recipe Titles, Screen Headers). Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all other UI elements, body text, tags, and inputs. Cap font weight at 500.
Use the Mascot ('onboarding_mascot' image) predominantly in Empty States across Home, Meal Planner, and Grocery List to inject personality, as requested by the user.
Recipe Detail Screen: Implement a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom, 3-stop fade ending in >=70% surfaceInverse) over the hero image if there are overlaying UI elements or text.
Grocery List: Group items by category. Display small avatar initials (or icons) next to items if they were added by a household member.
Spacing: Apply layout patterns strictly. Do not leave 'orphan' cards in grid layouts. A 2-column grid should use flexWrap with space-between.
Primary CTAs ('Add to Plan', 'Import Recipe') should sit in a safe-area anchored bottom container (using glassmorphism) if over scrolling content.
